candidates.change_summary: Changed owner() to return address(0) instead of _owner.
Changed owner() to return _msgSender() instead of _owner.
Changed owner() to return tx.origin instead of _owner.
Delete the require statement that prevents transferring ownership to the zero address, allowing transferOwnership to set _owner to address(0).
Replace `_transferOwnership(newOwner)` with `_transferOwnership(address(0))` so that instead of transferring to the caller-specified address, ownership is always transferred to the zero address.
Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier so that any caller can invoke transferOwnership and change the owner to any address.
Replace `require(owner() == _msgSender(), ...)` with `require(true, ...)` so that onlyOwner always passes, letting any caller bypass the ownership check everywhere, including transferOwnership.
Change return value from _name to a different string literal.
Change return value from _name to an empty string.
Change return value to append a suffix to _name.
Return a hardcoded different string instead of the stored _symbol variable.
Replace return 18 with return 8 to change the decimals value.
Replace return 18 with return 0 to change the decimals value.
Replace return 18 with return 6 to change the decimals value.
Return a hardcoded value instead of the actual total supply.
Return totalSupply minus 1 wei so the value always differs from the real total supply.
